The band is being represented by IKON internationally.

".  The official music video for the song was uploaded on May 27, 2014 to the band's Vevo channel on YouTube.  The song has been remixed by several artists, including Giorgio Moroder and Big Data. After the break-up of Sailor in the late 1970s, Kajanus decided to experiment with electronic music and formed DATA, together with vocalists Francesca ("Frankie") and Phillipa ("Phil") Boulter, daughters of British singer John Boulter.
